class.name: Authentication
class.brief_description: Players sign in with Google, Supabase, Firebase, Auth0 or any other service, and a server checks their tokens.

method.name: account_of
method.description: The account a token names ([code]"<service>:<id>"[/code]), read from it without checking it: empty when it is not of a service set up in [b]Project Settings > Authentication[/b]. A server checks tokens with [method check_token].

method.name: cancel_sign_in
method.description: Stops waiting for the sign-in that [method sign_in_with] started; [signal sign_in_failed] comes with the reason.

method.name: check_token
method.description: (A server.) Whether [param token] is valid for this game, with the keys of the service that signed it (read once, by itself; a service that signs with a secret gives it in the [code]GOBU_AUTH_SECRET[/code] environment variable). [param done] gets [code](account: String, reason: String)[/code]: the account, empty when the token is not valid, and why. Online's server does this for each player; a server of another networking calls it itself.

method.name: get_account
method.description: This game's account, [code]"<service>:<id>"[/code]: empty while it has not signed in.

method.name: get_session
method.description: The service's whole answer to the last sign-in ([code]refresh_token[/code], [code]expires_in[/code]...): empty while it has not signed in.

method.name: get_token
method.description: The session's token: the service's API takes it as [code]Authorization: Bearer <token>[/code]. Empty while it has not signed in.

method.name: is_signing_in
method.description: Whether a sign-in of [method sign_in_with] is waiting for the player.

method.name: sign_in_with
method.description: Signs in with a service: [code]"google"[/code], [code]"supabase"[/code], [code]"firebase"[/code], [code]"auth0"[/code] or [code]"custom"[/code], set up in [b]Project Settings > Authentication[/b]; or [code]"itch"[/code], with the game's itch.io OAuth application ([b]Authentication > Itch[/b]: its token [code]"itch:<token>"[/code] doesn't expire, a server checks it with itch.io's API, and the account is [code]"itch:<id>"[/code]); or [code]"crazygames"[/code], in a web game on CrazyGames with the CrazyGames plugin (its own sign-in; its token [code]"crazygames:<token>"[/code] lasts an hour and is checked with CrazyGames's keys for [b]Authentication > CrazyGames > Game Id[/b], the account is [code]"crazygames:<userId>"[/code]); or [code]"poki"[/code], in a web game on Poki with the Poki plugin (nothing to set up: Poki's own sign-in, and its token [code]"poki:<token>"[/code] lasts a minute, so sign in right before going online; a server checks it with Poki with the team key in its [code]GOBU_POKI_TEAM_KEY[/code] environment variable, and the account is [code]"poki:<user_id>"[/code]). [param options] wins over its section ([code]{"client_id": ...}[/code]). On a computer the service's page opens in the player's browser and comes back to this game (it waits up to 5 minutes); in a web game it opens in a window of its own (call it when the player presses a button: a browser blocks a window that opens by itself). Then [signal signed_in] or [signal sign_in_failed]. [constant ERR_BUSY] while another sign-in waits.

method.name: sign_out
method.description: Forgets the session: its token, its account. Then [signal signed_out].

signal.name: sign_in_failed
signal.description: The sign-in of [method sign_in_with] did not end well: the player closed it, the service refused it, or it was canceled ([method cancel_sign_in]).

signal.name: signed_in
signal.description: The player signed in: [param token] is the session's token ([method get_token]), [param data] the service's whole answer ([method get_session]).
